exposure: Trial of labor after two cesarean sections
cohort: 412 women who had given birth after two previous cesarean sections at a tertiary reference hospital between 2010 and 2017
finding: Trial of labor after two cesarean sections, particularly if unsuccessful, is linked to a higher risk of perinatal complications.
mod_finding: Trial of labor after two cesarean sections increases the risk of hemorrhage and unfavorable composite maternal outcome compared to repeat cesarean section.
